subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Inferir informações implícitas nos textos lidos.

components.description_pt: Identificar informações implicitamente transmitidas em um texto
components.description_en: Identify information that is implicitly conveyed in a text
components.cc_component_description: Identify explicit information stated directly in a text

components.description_pt: Fazer inferências de um texto informativo usando evidências textuais implícitas
components.description_en: Draw inferences from an informational text using implicit textual evidence
components.cc_component_description: Draw inferences from an informational text using implicit textual evidence

cc_matches.description: Cite textual evidence to support analysis of what the text says explicitly as well as inferences drawn from the text.
Read closely to determine what the text says explicitly and to make logical inferences from it; cite specific textual evidence when writing or speaking to support conclusions drawn from the text.
